# sphragisAI

> EU AI Act compliance and AI security consulting for small and mid-sized businesses, based in Greece. sphragisAI checks what a business signed with its AI vendors, what the EU AI Act requires of it, and how to harden its AI systems: mapping, gap analysis and monitoring. Founded by Maria Bartzoka (Μαρία Μπαρτζώκα), AI security and EU AI Act consultant. The name comes from the Greek σφραγίς (seal): proof that something is genuine and untampered. Previous name: theta ai.

Site languages: Greek (default, https://sphragisai.com/) and English (https://sphragisai.com/en/). Contact: info@sphragisai.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sphragisai/ (company), https://www.linkedin.com/in/mariabartzoka/ (founder).

## Services

- [ISO/IEC 42001 consulting (EN)](https://sphragisai.com/en/iso-42001/): gap assessment, AI management system set-up, internal audit before certification ([EL](https://sphragisai.com/iso-42001/))
- [sphragisAI home (EN)](https://sphragisai.com/en/): EU AI Act compliance and AI security services for SMBs
- [sphragisAI home (EL)](https://sphragisai.com/): the same in Greek
- [AI governance audit: what it includes](https://sphragisai.com/en/blog/ai-governance-audit-service/)
- [AI security audit: why running a scanner isn't enough](https://sphragisai.com/en/blog/ai-scanner-vs-audit/)

## AI Security Radar (updated daily)

Daily, source-verified briefing on the EU AI Act, AI security incidents and standards (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST). Every story has its own page with its original sources.

- [AI Security Radar (EN)](https://sphragisai.com/en/radar/): latest stories
- [AI Security Radar archive (EN)](https://sphragisai.com/en/radar/archive/): every story by month
- [AI Security Radar (EL)](https://sphragisai.com/radar/) and [archive (EL)](https://sphragisai.com/radar/archive/)
